event_description: A Proclamation, May 1, 2017, State of Emergency in the State of Mississippi. From FMCSA's copy: WHEREAS, the counties of Adams, Attala, Chickasaw, Claiborne, Clarke, Covington, Forrest, Grenada, Hinds, Holmes, Jefferson Davis, Jones, Lowndes, Madison, Montgomery, Rankin, Smith, Union, Warren, Yazoo and other parts of the State of Mississippi have been affected by severe thunderstorms on April 30, 2017, and continuing throughout the day, which includes torrential rain, damaging winds, hail, flooding, lightning and tornados

Mississippi Executive Order - 1582. From FMCSA's copy: on September 10, 2024, I issued a Proclamation declaring that a State of Emergency exists in the State of Mississippi due to the impact of Tropical Storm/Hurricane Francine beginning on September 9, 2024, and continuing

MISSISSIPPI EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1585. From FMCSA's copy: I issued a Proclamation declaring that a State of Emergency exists in the State of Mississippi as a result of expected prolonged freezing temperatures and winter weather, including snow and freezing rain beginning in the evening hours of January 9, 2025, and continuing

Mississippi Executive Order 1586 - Service Hours Waiver 1-18-25. From FMCSA's copy: I issued a Proclamation declaring that a State of Emergency exists in the State of Mississippi as a result of expected prolonged freezing temperatures and winter weather, including snow, freezing rain and ice beginning on January 19, 2025
